scene.label: Act 5, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. Rome. Before Titus's House

content.text: Enter Tamora and her two sons, disguised.

lines.text: Thus, in this strange and sad habiliment,
lines.plainText: Thus in this strange and sad habiliment

lines.text: I will encounter with Andronicus,
lines.plainText: I will encounter with Andronicus

lines.text: And say I am Revenge, sent from below
lines.plainText: And say I am Revenge sent from below

lines.text: To join with him and right his heinous wrongs.
lines.plainText: To join with him and right his heinous wrongs

lines.text: Knock at his study, where they say he keeps
lines.plainText: Knock at his study where they say he keeps

lines.text: To ruminate strange plots of dire revenge;
lines.plainText: To ruminate strange plots of dire revenge

lines.text: Tell him Revenge is come to join with him
lines.plainText: Tell him Revenge is come to join with him

lines.text: And work confusion on his enemies.
lines.plainText: And work confusion on his enemies

content.text: Titus above opens his study door.

lines.text: Who doth molest my contemplation?
lines.plainText: Who doth molest my contemplation

lines.text: Is it your trick to make me ope the door,
lines.plainText: Is it your trick to make me ope the door

lines.text: That so my sad decrees may fly away
lines.plainText: That so my sad decrees may fly away

lines.text: And all my study be to no effect?
lines.plainText: And all my study be to no effect

lines.text: You are deceived; for what I mean to do
lines.plainText: You are deceived for what I mean to do

lines.text: See here in bloody lines I have set down;
lines.plainText: See here in bloody lines I have set down

lines.text: And what is written shall be executed.
lines.plainText: And what is written shall be executed

lines.text: Titus, I am come to talk with thee.
lines.plainText: Titus I am come to talk with thee

lines.text: No, not a word; how can I grace my talk,
lines.plainText: No not a word how can I grace my talk

lines.text: Wanting a hand to give it action?
lines.plainText: Wanting a hand to give it action

lines.text: Thou hast the odds of me; therefore no more.
lines.plainText: Thou hast the odds of me therefore no more

lines.text: If thou didst know me, thou wouldst talk with me.
lines.plainText: If thou didst know me thou wouldst talk with me

lines.text: I am not mad; I know thee well enough.
lines.plainText: I am not mad I know thee well enough

lines.text: Witness this wretched stump, witness these crimson lines;
lines.plainText: Witness this wretched stump witness these crimson lines

lines.text: Witness these trenches made by grief and care;
lines.plainText: Witness these trenches made by grief and care

lines.text: Witness the tiring day and heavy night;
lines.plainText: Witness the tiring day and heavy night

lines.text: Witness all sorrow that I know thee well
lines.plainText: Witness all sorrow that I know thee well

lines.text: For our proud empress, mighty Tamora.
lines.plainText: For our proud empress mighty Tamora

lines.text: Is not thy coming for my other hand?
lines.plainText: Is not thy coming for my other hand

lines.text: Know thou, sad man, I am not Tamora;
lines.plainText: Know thou sad man I am not Tamora

lines.text: She is thy enemy, and I thy friend.
lines.plainText: She is thy enemy and I thy friend

lines.text: I am Revenge, sent from th' infernal kingdom
lines.plainText: I am Revenge sent from th' infernal kingdom

lines.text: To ease the gnawing vulture of thy mind
lines.plainText: To ease the gnawing vulture of thy mind

lines.text: By working wreakful vengeance on thy foes.
lines.plainText: By working wreakful vengeance on thy foes

lines.text: Come down and welcome me to this world's light;
lines.plainText: Come down and welcome me to this world's light

lines.text: Confer with me of murder and of death.
lines.plainText: Confer with me of murder and of death

lines.text: There's not a hollow cave or lurking-place,
lines.plainText: There's not a hollow cave or lurkingplace

lines.text: No vast obscurity or misty vale,
lines.plainText: No vast obscurity or misty vale

lines.text: Where bloody murder or detested rape
lines.plainText: Where bloody murder or detested rape

lines.text: Can couch for fear but I will find them out,
lines.plainText: Can couch for fear but I will find them out

lines.text: And in their ears tell them my dreadful name,
lines.plainText: And in their ears tell them my dreadful name

lines.text: Revenge, which makes the foul offender quake.
lines.plainText: Revenge which makes the foul offender quake

lines.text: Art thou Revenge? And art thou sent to me
lines.plainText: Art thou Revenge And art thou sent to me

lines.text: To be a torment to mine enemies?
lines.plainText: To be a torment to mine enemies

lines.text: I am; therefore come down and welcome me.
lines.plainText: I am therefore come down and welcome me

lines.text: Do me some service ere I come to thee.
lines.plainText: Do me some service ere I come to thee

lines.text: Lo, by thy side where Rape and Murder stands;
lines.plainText: Lo by thy side where Rape and Murder stands

lines.text: Now give some surance that thou art Revenge:
lines.plainText: Now give some surance that thou art Revenge

lines.text: Stab them, or tear them on thy chariot wheels,
lines.plainText: Stab them or tear them on thy chariot wheels

lines.text: And then I'll come and be thy waggoner,
lines.plainText: And then I'll come and be thy waggoner

lines.text: And whirl along with thee about the globe.
lines.plainText: And whirl along with thee about the globe

lines.text: Provide thee two proper palfreys, black as jet,
lines.plainText: Provide thee two proper palfreys black as jet

lines.text: To hale thy vengeful waggon swift away,
lines.plainText: To hale thy vengeful waggon swift away

lines.text: And find out murderers in their guilty caves.
lines.plainText: And find out murderers in their guilty caves

lines.text: And when thy car is loaden with their heads,
lines.plainText: And when thy car is loaden with their heads

lines.text: I will dismount, and by the waggon-wheel
lines.plainText: I will dismount and by the waggonwheel

lines.text: Trot like a servile footman all day long,
lines.plainText: Trot like a servile footman all day long

lines.text: Even from Hyperion's rising in the east
lines.plainText: Even from Hyperion's rising in the east

lines.text: Until his very downfall in the sea.
lines.plainText: Until his very downfall in the sea

lines.text: And day by day I'll do this heavy task,
lines.plainText: And day by day I'll do this heavy task

lines.text: So thou destroy Rapine and Murder there.
lines.plainText: So thou destroy Rapine and Murder there

lines.text: These are my ministers, and come with me.
lines.plainText: These are my ministers and come with me

lines.text: Are they thy ministers? What are they called?
lines.plainText: Are they thy ministers What are they called

lines.text: Rapine and Murder; therefore called so
lines.plainText: Rapine and Murder therefore called so

lines.text: 'Cause they take vengeance of such kind of men.
lines.plainText: 'Cause they take vengeance of such kind of men

lines.text: Good Lord, how like the empress' sons they are,
lines.plainText: Good Lord how like the empress' sons they are

lines.text: And you the empress! But we worldly men
lines.plainText: And you the empress But we worldly men

lines.text: Have miserable, mad, mistaking eyes.
lines.plainText: Have miserable mad mistaking eyes

lines.text: O sweet Revenge, now do I come to thee;
lines.plainText: O sweet Revenge now do I come to thee

lines.text: And, if one arm's embracement will content thee,
lines.plainText: And if one arm's embracement will content thee

lines.text: I will embrace thee in it by and by.
lines.plainText: I will embrace thee in it by and by

lines.text: This closing with him fits his lunacy.
lines.plainText: This closing with him fits his lunacy

lines.text: Whate'er I forge to feed his brain-sick humours,
lines.plainText: Whate'er I forge to feed his brainsick humours

lines.text: Do you uphold and maintain in your speeches,
lines.plainText: Do you uphold and maintain in your speeches

lines.text: For now he firmly takes me for Revenge;
lines.plainText: For now he firmly takes me for Revenge

lines.text: And, being credulous in this mad thought,
lines.plainText: And being credulous in this mad thought

lines.text: I'll make him send for Lucius his son;
lines.plainText: I'll make him send for Lucius his son

lines.text: And whilst I at a banquet hold him sure,
lines.plainText: And whilst I at a banquet hold him sure

lines.text: I'll find some cunning practice out of hand
lines.plainText: I'll find some cunning practice out of hand

lines.text: To scatter and disperse the giddy Goths,
lines.plainText: To scatter and disperse the giddy Goths

lines.text: Or, at the least, make them his enemies.
lines.plainText: Or at the least make them his enemies

lines.text: See, here he comes, and I must ply my theme.
lines.plainText: See here he comes and I must ply my theme

lines.text: Long have I been forlorn, and all for thee.
lines.plainText: Long have I been forlorn and all for thee

lines.text: Welcome, dread Fury, to my woeful house.
lines.plainText: Welcome dread Fury to my woeful house

lines.text: Rapine and Murder, you are welcome too.
lines.plainText: Rapine and Murder you are welcome too

lines.text: How like the empress and her sons you are!
lines.plainText: How like the empress and her sons you are

lines.text: Well are you fitted, had you but a Moor.
lines.plainText: Well are you fitted had you but a Moor

lines.text: Could not all hell afford you such a devil?
lines.plainText: Could not all hell afford you such a devil

lines.text: For well I wot the empress never wags
lines.plainText: For well I wot the empress never wags

lines.text: But in her company there is a Moor;
lines.plainText: But in her company there is a Moor

lines.text: And, would you represent our queen aright,
lines.plainText: And would you represent our queen aright

lines.text: It were convenient you had such a devil.
lines.plainText: It were convenient you had such a devil

lines.text: But welcome as you are. What shall we do?
lines.plainText: But welcome as you are What shall we do

lines.text: What wouldst thou have us do, Andronicus?
lines.plainText: What wouldst thou have us do Andronicus

lines.text: Show me a murderer, I'll deal with him.
lines.plainText: Show me a murderer I'll deal with him

lines.text: Show me a villain that hath done a rape,
lines.plainText: Show me a villain that hath done a rape

lines.text: And I am sent to be revenged on him.
lines.plainText: And I am sent to be revenged on him

lines.text: Show me a thousand that hath done thee wrong,
lines.plainText: Show me a thousand that hath done thee wrong

lines.text: And I will be revenged on them all.
lines.plainText: And I will be revenged on them all

lines.text: Look round about the wicked streets of Rome,
lines.plainText: Look round about the wicked streets of Rome

lines.text: And when thou find'st a man that's like thyself,
lines.plainText: And when thou find'st a man that's like thyself

lines.text: Good Murder, stab him; he's a murderer.
lines.plainText: Good Murder stab him he's a murderer

lines.text: Go thou with him; and when it is thy hap
lines.plainText: Go thou with him and when it is thy hap

lines.text: To find another that is like to thee,
lines.plainText: To find another that is like to thee

lines.text: Good Rapine, stab him; he is a ravisher.
lines.plainText: Good Rapine stab him he is a ravisher

lines.text: Go thou with them; and in the emperor's court
lines.plainText: Go thou with them and in the emperor's court

lines.text: There is a queen, attended by a Moor;
lines.plainText: There is a queen attended by a Moor

lines.text: Well shalt thou know her by thine own proportion,
lines.plainText: Well shalt thou know her by thine own proportion

lines.text: For up and down she doth resemble thee.
lines.plainText: For up and down she doth resemble thee

lines.text: I pray thee, do on them some violent death;
lines.plainText: I pray thee do on them some violent death

lines.text: They have been violent to me and mine.
lines.plainText: They have been violent to me and mine

lines.text: Well hast thou lessoned us; this shall we do.
lines.plainText: Well hast thou lessoned us this shall we do

lines.text: But would it please thee, good Andronicus,
lines.plainText: But would it please thee good Andronicus

lines.text: To send for Lucius, thy thrice-valiant son,
lines.plainText: To send for Lucius thy thricevaliant son

lines.text: Who leads towards Rome a band of warlike Goths,
lines.plainText: Who leads towards Rome a band of warlike Goths

lines.text: And bid him come and banquet at thy house?
lines.plainText: And bid him come and banquet at thy house

lines.text: When he is here, even at thy solemn feast,
lines.plainText: When he is here even at thy solemn feast

lines.text: I will bring in the empress and her sons,
lines.plainText: I will bring in the empress and her sons

lines.text: The emperor himself, and all thy foes,
lines.plainText: The emperor himself and all thy foes

lines.text: And at thy mercy shall they stoop and kneel,
lines.plainText: And at thy mercy shall they stoop and kneel

lines.text: And on them shalt thou ease thy angry heart.
lines.plainText: And on them shalt thou ease thy angry heart

lines.text: What says Andronicus to this device?
lines.plainText: What says Andronicus to this device

lines.text: Marcus, my brother, 'tis sad Titus calls.
lines.plainText: Marcus my brother 'tis sad Titus calls

lines.text: This will I do, and soon return again.
lines.plainText: This will I do and soon return again

lines.text: Now will I hence about thy business,
lines.plainText: Now will I hence about thy business

lines.text: And take my ministers along with me.
lines.plainText: And take my ministers along with me

lines.text: Nay, nay, let Rape and Murder stay with me,
lines.plainText: Nay nay let Rape and Murder stay with me

lines.text: Or else I'll call my brother back again
lines.plainText: Or else I'll call my brother back again

lines.text: And cleave to no revenge but Lucius.
lines.plainText: And cleave to no revenge but Lucius

lines.text: [Aside to them.] What say you, boys? Will you abide with him,
lines.plainText: Aside to them What say you boys Will you abide with him

lines.text: Whiles I go tell my lord the emperor
lines.plainText: Whiles I go tell my lord the emperor

lines.text: How I have governed our determined jest?
lines.plainText: How I have governed our determined jest

lines.text: Yield to his humour, smooth and speak him fair,
lines.plainText: Yield to his humour smooth and speak him fair

lines.text: And tarry with him till I come again.
lines.plainText: And tarry with him till I come again

lines.text: [Aside.] I knew them all, though they suppose me mad,
lines.plainText: Aside I knew them all though they suppose me mad

lines.text: And will o'erreach them in their own devices,
lines.plainText: And will o'erreach them in their own devices

lines.text: A pair of cursed hell-hounds and their dam.
lines.plainText: A pair of cursed hellhounds and their dam

lines.text: Madam, depart at pleasure; leave us here.
lines.plainText: Madam depart at pleasure leave us here

lines.text: Farewell, Andronicus. Revenge now goes
lines.plainText: Farewell Andronicus Revenge now goes

lines.text: To lay a complot to betray thy foes.
lines.plainText: To lay a complot to betray thy foes

lines.text: I know thou dost; and, sweet Revenge, farewell.
lines.plainText: I know thou dost and sweet Revenge farewell

lines.text: Tell us, old man, how shall we be employed?
lines.plainText: Tell us old man how shall we be employed

lines.text: Tut, I have work enough for you to do.
lines.plainText: Tut I have work enough for you to do

lines.text: Publius, come hither, Caius, and Valentine.
lines.plainText: Publius come hither Caius and Valentine

lines.text: What is your will?
lines.plainText: What is your will

lines.text: Know you these two?
lines.plainText: Know you these two

lines.text: The empress' sons, I take them, Chiron, Demetrius.
lines.plainText: The empress' sons I take them Chiron Demetrius

lines.text: Fie, Publius, fie, thou art too much deceived.
lines.plainText: Fie Publius fie thou art too much deceived

lines.text: The one is Murder, and Rape is the other's name;
lines.plainText: The one is Murder and Rape is the other's name

lines.text: And therefore bind them, gentle Publius.
lines.plainText: And therefore bind them gentle Publius

lines.text: Caius and Valentine, lay hands on them.
lines.plainText: Caius and Valentine lay hands on them

lines.text: Oft have you heard me wish for such an hour,
lines.plainText: Oft have you heard me wish for such an hour

lines.text: And now I find it. Therefore bind them sure,
lines.plainText: And now I find it Therefore bind them sure

lines.text: And stop their mouths if they begin to cry.
lines.plainText: And stop their mouths if they begin to cry

lines.text: Villains, forbear! We are the empress' sons.
lines.plainText: Villains forbear We are the empress' sons

lines.text: And therefore do we what we are commanded.
lines.plainText: And therefore do we what we are commanded

lines.text: Stop close their mouths, let them not speak a word.
lines.plainText: Stop close their mouths let them not speak a word

lines.text: Is he sure bound? Look that you bind them fast.
lines.plainText: Is he sure bound Look that you bind them fast

content.text: Enter Titus Andronicus with a knife, and Lavinia with a basin.

lines.text: Come, come, Lavinia; look, thy foes are bound.
lines.plainText: Come come Lavinia look thy foes are bound

lines.text: Sirs, stop their mouths, let them not speak to me,
lines.plainText: Sirs stop their mouths let them not speak to me

lines.text: But let them hear what fearful words I utter.
lines.plainText: But let them hear what fearful words I utter

lines.text: O villains, Chiron and Demetrius!
lines.plainText: O villains Chiron and Demetrius

lines.text: Here stands the spring whom you have stained with mud,
lines.plainText: Here stands the spring whom you have stained with mud

lines.text: This goodly summer with your winter mixed.
lines.plainText: This goodly summer with your winter mixed

lines.text: You killed her husband, and for that vile fault
lines.plainText: You killed her husband and for that vile fault

lines.text: Two of her brothers were condemned to death,
lines.plainText: Two of her brothers were condemned to death

lines.text: My hand cut off and made a merry jest,
lines.plainText: My hand cut off and made a merry jest

lines.text: Both her sweet hands, her tongue, and that more dear
lines.plainText: Both her sweet hands her tongue and that more dear

lines.text: Than hands or tongue, her spotless chastity,
lines.plainText: Than hands or tongue her spotless chastity

lines.text: Inhuman traitors, you constrained and forced.
lines.plainText: Inhuman traitors you constrained and forced

lines.text: What would you say if I should let you speak?
lines.plainText: What would you say if I should let you speak

lines.text: Villains, for shame you could not beg for grace.
lines.plainText: Villains for shame you could not beg for grace

lines.text: Hark, wretches, how I mean to martyr you.
lines.plainText: Hark wretches how I mean to martyr you

lines.text: This one hand yet is left to cut your throats,
lines.plainText: This one hand yet is left to cut your throats

lines.text: Whiles that Lavinia 'tween her stumps doth hold
lines.plainText: Whiles that Lavinia 'tween her stumps doth hold

lines.text: The basin that receives your guilty blood.
lines.plainText: The basin that receives your guilty blood

lines.text: You know your mother means to feast with me,
lines.plainText: You know your mother means to feast with me

lines.text: And calls herself Revenge, and thinks me mad.
lines.plainText: And calls herself Revenge and thinks me mad

lines.text: Hark, villains! I will grind your bones to dust,
lines.plainText: Hark villains I will grind your bones to dust

lines.text: And with your blood and it I'll make a paste,
lines.plainText: And with your blood and it I'll make a paste

lines.text: And of the paste a coffin I will rear,
lines.plainText: And of the paste a coffin I will rear

lines.text: And make two pasties of your shameful heads,
lines.plainText: And make two pasties of your shameful heads

lines.text: And bid that strumpet, your unhallowed dam,
lines.plainText: And bid that strumpet your unhallowed dam

lines.text: Like to the earth swallow her own increase.
lines.plainText: Like to the earth swallow her own increase

lines.text: This is the feast that I have bid her to,
lines.plainText: This is the feast that I have bid her to

lines.text: And this the banquet she shall surfeit on;
lines.plainText: And this the banquet she shall surfeit on

lines.text: For worse than Philomel you used my daughter,
lines.plainText: For worse than Philomel you used my daughter

lines.text: And worse than Procne I will be revenged.
lines.plainText: And worse than Procne I will be revenged

lines.text: And now prepare your throats.—Lavinia, come
lines.plainText: And now prepare your throatsLavinia come

lines.text: Receive the blood.
lines.plainText: Receive the blood
